safe_test: Publish useful forward-looking content, not fictitious 2027 testing or a promise of first-mover rankings.
stop_or_gate: Exact public copy and destination approval; later index and referral observations.

safe_test: arXiv expects scholarly content; Zenodo is a research repository. Do not disguise a commercial listicle as a paper.
stop_or_gate: A real research question, dataset, method and archive eligibility, not an SEO advert.

safe_test: A useful extension can have a listing; a backlink-only wrapper is not a product. Store registration may require a fee.
stop_or_gate: Existing developer-account eligibility or scoped fee approval plus product/security/store review.

safe_test: A concise answer-first article is testable. No universal 330-word threshold or #1-source claim is established.
stop_or_gate: Exact article/account/destination approval; then rendered link and real referral checks.

safe_test: Publish only a real open role. Do not invent jobs or candidates to manufacture branded search.
stop_or_gate: A genuine vacancy, approved role details and hiring owner; branded-search ranking causality unproven.

safe_test: Buying and redirecting a site is an acquisition, not a free experiment. Reject expired-domain abuse and assume no ranking transfer.
stop_or_gate: Named asset, due diligence, budget and scoped ownership/redirect approval.

safe_test: Publish a genuinely useful table with criteria and disclosure. Do not rig an allegedly independent comparison by putting the sponsor first.
stop_or_gate: Exact public Sheet/account/copy approval; publishing exposes the data; verify actual links and privacy.

safe_test: Use an accurate initial title and natural URL. Do not bait-and-switch titles or claim that a keyword slug guarantees ranking.
stop_or_gate: Actual draft editor and approved article; immutable-slug claim not independently verified.

safe_test: One useful deck can be tested. Ten decks or one per query is not evidence of value or indexation.
stop_or_gate: Exact deck/account/destination approval and current public-sharing limits; no ten-deck rollout.

safe_test: Use genuine open technical documentation or an educational resource. GitHub Pages is not free hosting for a commercial SaaS business.
stop_or_gate: Approved rights-safe repository/site and exact resource copy; Pages terms reviewed before deployment.

safe_test: Answer a real relevant question using expertise, disclosure and platform rules. No answer-count or traffic guarantee.
stop_or_gate: A current relevant question, actual author/account and exact-answer approval; search access was inconclusive.
